scope: User-requested complete remaining registered data matrix: Main split; Receiver splits 1 and 2; 10-class; 1% and 5% labeled; 2, 3, 4 and 6 source receivers. For each, compare two existing multibranch physics-aware SSL methods and seeds 2026092701/02/03: 10 settings x 2 methods x 3 seeds = 60 new rows. Previously completed single-source-receiver results for both methods are reused and not retrained. Main split is explicitly included under the user's latest instruction. No leo_weak.

methods.name: hybrid
methods.mechanism: The previously tested fusion-plus-five-branch same-packet physical contrast, original Tri joint contrast coefficient, temperature 0.2 and accepted different-pseudoclass negatives. Preserve source-day branch relation, true source-L four-of-five certification, tapered source physical views and separate U/L branch gradient guard.

methods.name: branch_prototype
methods.mechanism: The same physical hybrid plus the previously tested branch-only class prototype loss. Current true source-L batch provides detached five-branch centers, excluding each U query's source date; skip missing-class anchors. Use only accepted and certified physical U slots. Temperature 0.2 and original joint coefficient; one additional no-gradient source-L forward per U batch.

grouping: Keep cross-day L certificate and cross-day five-branch relation for both methods, exactly as in the original single-receiver experiments. For single source RX, the existing Tri style/extrapolation requires source-day substitution; the already completed row is reused. For multiple source RX, retain actual receiver metadata in original Tri style/extrapolation instead of treating a date as a receiver. This adaptation preserves access to available physical RX structure and is disclosed when comparing the single-RX results.
initialization: Each row continues from exact same-setting same-seed source-only original Tri E20; Main split uses the original shuffled three-view run and all others use that setting's paper Tri E20. The complete E50 parent evidence, source data roles and physical IDs, receiver/day/class contract and inherited original REPL options must match. Each candidate completes its own E30 and fixed E50/11100; no target data, U truth, foreign initialization, post-hoc checkpoint selection or test-driven adjustment.
controls: same-setting and same-seed ordinary PL, reused without retraining
same-setting and same-seed original Tri-SIG-TIME SSL, reused without retraining
previously completed same-seed single-RX outputs for both methods
evaluation: All 60 predictions must finish and freeze before independent truth-last scoring. For each setting, seed and method use the same physical IDs, clean and six practical satellite-ground scenes, DURA-LU primary and DURA-L/raw secondary, with cross-date, cross-RX and cross-both separately and cross-RX/cross-both combined where valid. Record every scene and seed, TX/RX/day, paired corrections/regressions and baseline scores. Do not select a checkpoint, drop rows or selectively rerun from test results.
interpretation: Existing results guided selection of the two methods and much of this same test matrix has been seen during development; this full matrix is an exploratory follow-up, not independent confirmatory evidence. Report negative and positive outcomes, confidence/seed variation and costs. Cross-setting generalization is established only for settings actually completed; a separate unseen confirmation is needed for a confirmatory claim.
success: Assess whether each method improves on matched Tri and exceeds ordinary PL by more than 2 percentage points for clean and each practical DURA-LU scene, including individual seeds and distinct test populations. No promise that either method meets every threshold.
expected_artifacts: 60 fixed E50 source models and objective counters
60 independent truth-last scores and matched seed/scene/subgroup paired analysis
Complete 11-setting comparison including the two reused source_rx_1 results
